intro_html: White chicken chili is creamy, comforting, and quietly loaded with protein. Cannellini beans make it filling and the coconut milk gives it that rich body without breaking the bank. One batch makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $3.94 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings lands around 65g protein for about 575 calories, at roughly $2.60 a bowl.
upsell_html: This is a seriously high-protein bowl, and it tastes like pure comfort while it fuels you up. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Canned cannellini beans are the cheap, protein-packed backbone of this chili, so stock up when they go on sale.
Coconut milk gives you a rich, creamy base for less than cream or half-and-half.
Buy the chicken breast in a value pack to keep every bowl affordable.
make_it: Add the chicken breast, chopped onion, and diced bell peppers to the crock.
Pour in both cans of coconut milk.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the drained cannellini beans.
Let it warm through and thicken for another 20 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and dig in.
